domain.Identity, grain and relationships: One named business GENTRY. Owner is Hassan; Operations Manager is Omar; Support is Hadeer as historical holders, not immutable identities.
Unique `Name`/order reference `#NNNN`. Shopify export is line-item grain; `Orders_Master` is one row per order, 24 columns.
Tracking number as text. One order can generate multiple legs; shipment master 55 columns. `SEND`, `RTO`, `CUSTOMER_RETURN_PICKUP`, `EXCHANGE_return` are distinct types.
Shopify Name matches Bosta Business Reference Number, not tracking. Historical 227/234 match claim; misses before Shopify export window. These rows were not reverified here.
Return log `order ID` means Bosta tracking number, not Shopify order reference. A row retains free-text customer reason, contact outcome, attempt count, root cause, fit detail, resolution.
Legacy repeat-customer identity keyed by phone; two numbers can appear as two customers. Customer identity is not proved globally unique.
Return attempts stored as a number; confirmation attempts encoded by `1/3`, `2/3`, `3/3` tags, replace previous tag. No event timestamps or attempt entities established.
Separate from courier reason and call reach status. One root-cause category maps to Product, Customer, Courier, Ops or Unknown.
Variant label must match Bosta Description exactly; source Shopify price/cost, 51 historical variants. Parses at most four item slots in original shipment master.
RAW_Costs Order Id joins tracking; multiple fee lines should sum; actual fee overrides modeled rate card.
COD amount may be zero on returned legs; valued via SKU price then measured AOV proxy. Shopify paid/voided/refunded used to infer pickup outcome.
Recorded shipping method `90 Office`; inferred unrecorded pickup has paid, not cancelled, no Bosta row, not office method, beyond 2-day settling window.
Weekly report sidecar action has ID, action, owner, due, effort, optional refs and success condition. Human/agent determines DONE/OPEN/SLIPPED/DROPPED.
